title: Todoist Waiting Label Backlog
app: Obsidian Sync, Todoist, Toggl Track, Google Calendar / iCloud calendar exports, and task metadata ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=todoist:task label="waiting"
| stats count as waiting_tasks by project
| where waiting_tasks>5
| sort - waiting_tasks
description: Uses Todoist waiting-on tasks telemetry to monitor how much delegated or blocked work is stacking up in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for projects that are waiting on too many external dependencies, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Todoist waiting-on tasks data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It frames how much delegated or blocked work is stacking up so you can spot projects that are waiting on too many external dependencies before it becomes annoying.
